Atomic Physics
Atom isthesmallestpartofmatterwhichtakespartinchemicalreactions
Atoms of the same element are similar in mass Size and characteristics
Atom consists of three fundamental particles electron, proton and
neutron. All the protons and neutrons are present in the central core of
atom called nucleus. Electrons revolve around the nucleus_
In an atom, electrons and protons are equal in number and have equal
and opposite charge Hence atom is neutral
